(operate_content LIKE '%生成%' OR operate_type IN ('GENERATE_SQL'))

(operate_type IN ('LOGIN', 'CHANGE_PASSWORD') OR operate_content LIKE '%登录%' OR operate_content LIKE '%密码%')
AND operate_type = #{operateType}
AND operate_time >= #{startTime}
AND operate_time <= #{endTime}
ORDER BY operate_time DESC
